versions.name: Camp Clark / Adventure Cove

features.note: group campsites built around three-sided shelters
each campsite has its own dining shelter

versions.summary: Family camping site on the 780-acre Meriwether/Clark Scout Reservation at Cape Lookout, south of Tillamook: forest campsites and family cabins with beachfront, tidepools, trails, and hot-shower bathhouses. It no longer runs a formal camp program.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a unit that attended 2026-08-14 (submission xVlMjDd), kept anonymous at submitter request. The council's Camp Clark page confirms no formal summer-camp program runs and the site is open to Scouting families for coastal family camping only, so operating_status is not_operating and the shooting-sports (archery, bb_guns) and handicraft program features were removed.
Coordinate set 2026-08-14 to the submitter's attended-location pin at Cape Lookout (approximate); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. July normals cleared pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
